summary: ZFS provision tests cover spare RequiresErase wipe, ineligible spare refusal, and autoreplace=on on create; storage monitor clears ZFSPool on probe deadline; ZFS-by-host UI marks stale pool lines Last report and gates Replace on observation freshness.

guide.reason: Replace disk requires a current pool observation; a Last report prefix marks stale by-host pool lines.

api.reason: No Controller/Core contract change; probe overlay clears ephemeral ZFSPool on deadline and UI freshness gating uses existing observed_at and connection fields.

roadmap.reason: Regression coverage and observation honesty for existing ZFS provision/monitor behaviour.

state.reason: Ephemeral access overlay and UI presentation only; durable pool state remains the zpool and existing provision journal.

verification.method: go test ./internal/vmhost/ -count=1 -run 'TestZFSProvision(WipesARequiresEraseSpare|RefusesAnIneligibleSpare|CreateEnablesAutoreplace|CreateOmitsAutoreplace)|TestStorageMonitorDeadlineClearsPlacementAccess'; node web/src/storage.test.mjs; python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree
